structured_output.title: Pebble upgrade affects only cert-manager's ACME E2E test suite
structured_output.content: The change upgrades Pebble to v2.7.0 and adjusts ACME E2E tests. The release notes list it under "Other (Cleanup or Flake)", so it concerns the project's test infrastructure rather than shipped runtime behavior. The environment summary shows only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests, the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD, and four values keys, none tied to test tooling. The excerpt states no change to runtime ACME behavior.
